scope.block: planning, in-loop record checking, and cleanup
scope.secondary: source-reach-weighted planning only; excludes batch cleanup
scope.repeats: six timing repetitions of fixed graphs and queries; no independent-query CI
scope.quality: V55/V56 policy certificate reused; no new quality evaluation
scope.source_bytes: frozen source bytes compared by runner before timing

accounting.partition_note: warmup and measured partition all_blocks; timing component views are not additive totals

retained_V52.scope: All case costs are retained, including invalid or incomplete certificates. Old environment and supervised training costs remain in their original reports; none is refunded or charged again here.

retained_V53.scope: Every cold decision and policy traversal is charged once. Reach-weighted decision work estimates one executed policy trajectory and is not added to exhaustive case work. Serialization is separate. V52 costs are retained as historical work, without refund or inclusion in new work.

retained_V54.scope: All interrupted and completed decisions, policy evaluations and serializations remain charged. Limits are checked after a paid cold decision, so an overshooting decision is included in full. Reach-weighted work is a separate expected trajectory quantity, not an extra cost. V53 remains historical work.

control.scope: The fresh and regression ledgers partition all new work and are not added a second time. Total candidate work includes both prefix and refinement; reach-weighted work is a separate trajectory expectation. All interrupted work remains charged. V54 regression controls are historical, not new evaluations.

retained_V52.scope: All case costs are retained, including invalid or incomplete certificates. Old environment and supervised training costs remain in their original reports; none is refunded or charged again here.

retained_V53.scope: Every cold decision and policy traversal is charged once. Reach-weighted decision work estimates one executed policy trajectory and is not added to exhaustive case work. Serialization is separate. V52 costs are retained as historical work, without refund or inclusion in new work.

retained_V54.scope: All interrupted and completed decisions, policy evaluations and serializations remain charged. V53 remains historical work.

retained_V55.scope: The fresh and regression ledgers partition all new work and are not added a second time. Total candidate work includes both prefix and refinement; reach-weighted work is a separate trajectory expectation. All interrupted work remains charged. V54 regression controls are historical, not new evaluations.

analytic.scope: All complete and interrupted cold decisions remain charged. No new outer policy evaluation or environmental sample is used. Old full-policy work is retained, not recharged. Source-weighted work describes the old occupancy distribution and supports actual policy-decision cost interpretation only when every action and value certificate is preserved.

historical_cost_scope: source ledgers retained separately; never added to new costs or refunded
